lounges.name: VIP Lounge Costa Rica / VIP MasterCard
lounges.location: Upper level near Gate 19, after security and passport control. Distinct from the neighbouring BAC Credomatic lounge.

sources.title: Priority Pass · VIP Lounge Costa Rica
San José airport · VIP MasterCard location, facilities and access agreements

lounges.note: The airport calls the Gate 19 Priority Pass facility VIP MasterCard; older listings also use Copa Club. Breakfast runs to 11:00, lunch to 15:00, then snacks. Showers require availability or a reservation; confirm any charge. Airline and bank agreements are not blanket cabin or alliance entitlements.

recommendation.summary: The Gate 19 Priority Pass option with confirmed showers, subject to availability.

lounges.name: VIP Santamaria / VIP VISA
lounges.location: Level 3 near Gate 5, after security and passport control; the airport calls this facility VIP VISA.

hours.note: Priority Pass publishes 04:30 opening; the airport publishes 04:00. Use 04:30 conservatively and confirm earlier admission directly.

accessRules.label: Priority Pass
conditions: Present your Priority Pass membership credential; direct payment-card entry is not accepted under this program listing.

sources.title: Priority Pass · VIP Santamaria and food charges
San José airport · Gate 5 VIP VISA lounge

lounges.note: Priority Pass says the food menu costs extra; confirm the included meal benefit before relying on it. The airport lists breakfast, lunch and afternoon snacks but does not establish a buffet or restaurant service style. Other airline/bank invitations remain unmodeled.

recommendation.summary: A Gate 5 alternative for Priority Pass; check meal charges and the earlier-opening discrepancy.
